name: smiles-hover
description: Hover any SMILES string to see its 2D molecular structure, rendered with RDKit in ChemDraw style. Reaction SMILES are drawn with arrows. Molecules on screen are found automatically. No setup required.

smilesHover.autoDetect.description: Find SMILES on screen automatically and draw them ahead of time, so hovering any molecule shows it. Tokens RDKit doesn't parse are ignored. Turn off to only show molecules you render explicitly.

smilesHover.autoDetectMinLength.description: Shortest featureless token auto-detection will consider. Short uppercase strings are valid molecules but rarely meant as ones (CNN, ISC, CSS). Exempt, at any length: values after a `smiles:` key, a line holding nothing else, and files whose header row names a SMILES column.

smilesHover.maxPrerender.description: How many molecules to draw ahead of time per screenful. Beyond this, detected molecules are still hoverable, just drawn on demand.

smilesHover.imageWidth.description: Base width of the rendered molecule (px). Larger structures scale up from this unless autoSize is off.

smilesHover.imageHeight.description: Base height of the rendered molecule (px). Larger structures scale up from this unless autoSize is off.

smilesHover.maxHoverWidth.description: Maximum width the molecule is displayed at inside the hover (px). VS Code clips hover content rather than scaling it, so this keeps the whole structure visible.

smilesHover.maxHoverHeight.description: Maximum height the molecule is displayed at inside the hover (px). VS Code's hover is roughly a quarter of the editor height; raise this if you have a tall editor and want bigger structures.

smilesHover.autoSize.description: Size the canvas from the molecule's 2D layout, so every structure is drawn at the same scale and line weight. Turn off to always render at exactly imageWidth x imageHeight.

smilesHover.retentionMinutes.description: How long a molecule you've rendered stays hoverable, in minutes. Hovering that span again within this window re-shows it without re-rendering.

enumDescriptions: ChemDraw-style: muted, publication-friendly colors on white
Vivid CPK-like colors (saturated red O, blue N, etc.)
Pure black on white, no atom coloring

commands.title: SMILES Hover: Show Molecule for Selection

scripts.compile: npm run vendor && tsc -p ./ && npm run compile:renderer
